regulatory_framework.EU_AI_Act: Annex IV High-Risk AI System — Article 13 Transparency

model_details.architecture: NeuroForge CANRP-X v3.0 — Ensemble Neuro-AI Decoder

intended_use.primary_purpose: Decode cortical motor intent from μECoG signals and deliver phase-locked epidural spinal cord stimulation for motor restoration in patients with complete paralysis.
intended_use.intended_users: Implanting neurosurgeons, rehabilitation engineers, clinical operators.
intended_use.intended_population: Adults (18+) with complete SCI (AIS-A), Brainstem Stroke, or ALS. Contraindicated for pediatric use or active cardiac implants.
intended_use.out_of_scope_uses: Emotion decoding, speech-BCI, diagnostic imaging analysis. Not validated for incomplete SCI (AIS-B/C/D).

training_data.description: Synthetic multimodal data generated by coupled Jansen-Rit neural mass models, Izhikevich CPG simulation, and MuJoCo 14-DoF biomechanical model.
training_data.bias_notes: Synthetic data may not fully capture inter-subject electrode drift, pathological epileptiform activity, or chronic impedance degradation.

safety_mechanisms: Shannon charge-density k-limit (≤1.75) enforced per stimulation pulse.
Cole-Cole α<0.70 biofouling alert with auto voltage scaling.

explainability.regulatory_relevance: Verifies that beta desynchronization and high-gamma activity drive stimulation decisions, not motion artifacts or line noise.
